scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test

comments.stack: The GSN API's stack on purpose (auth-plan.md section 12.4): Nest 11 on Fastify, Zod configuration, Vitest. The credential services move here from the API in part 4 with their tests, without a rewrite.
comments.views: Server-rendered pages (Eta through @fastify/view), not a single-page app: accepting a login calls Hydra's admin API, which only a server may reach, and the screens must work before any JavaScript loads (section 7.4).
comments.no-shell: `dev` passes --no-shell for the same reason as the API: this repository sits under a path with an & in it, and the Nest CLI's shell spawn splits the command there.
comments.npm: npm 11.3 crashes resolving vitest's dependency tree (TypeError: reading 'edgesOut' in buildIdealTree); 11.6.2 does not. Install with `npx npm@11.6.2 install` until the machine's npm is newer.
